description_en: Adds an elastic IP address (EIP) to an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用AddCommonBandwidthPackageIp接口添加EIP到共享带宽中
kebab_example: aliyun vpc add-common-bandwidth-package-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-2ze2ic1xd2qeqasdf0000 --ip-instance-id eip-2zeerraiwb7uqwed0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCommonBandwidthPackageIp

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. 

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
共享带宽所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the EIP instance. 

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36018.html to query the ID of the EIP instance
parameters.help_zh:
EIP实例的ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36018.html接口查询EIP实例的ID。
parameters.name: ip_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP type. Valid values: EIP, which indicates that an EIP is added to the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.help_zh: IP类型。取值：EIP，表示将EIP添加至共享带宽
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run without actually executing the operation
parameters.name: dry_run
